Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config

Class AIConfig

java.lang.Object
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config.AIConfig
public final class AIConfig extends Object
An app's AI configuration, loaded and validated by AIConfigLoader: the gateways of its parent (global) file, the models the app uses with their merged settings, and the app's roots, named pools of entry models. Immutable.
